cases.prompt: 我们讨论一下冲刺攻击是否应该消耗耐力，帮我比较几种玩法取舍。
invariants: distinguishes user goals from assumptions
compares no more than three meaningful options
recommends a bounded gameplay experiment
does not create implementation work

cases.prompt: 把冲刺冷却从 0.8 秒改成 0.6 秒并运行测试。
invariants: does not inject advisory analysis into an ordinary implementation request

cases.prompt: 评估一下为什么第一次玩的玩家总是不知道受伤后该往哪里走。
invariants: anchors findings to a player moment
considers goal clarity, feedback, onboarding, and recovery
does not prescribe UI code

cases.prompt: 我们只有两周，讨论一下 Boss 战垂直切片必须保留什么、应该砍什么。
invariants: protects a coherent player promise
names inclusions and exclusions
identifies the largest uncertainty and cheapest test
does not write a sprint plan

cases.prompt: 根据这次试玩的输入轨迹、状态截图和玩家反馈做复盘，判断最应该先验证什么。
invariants: separates observations from interpretations
states confidence and alternative causes
prioritizes at most three findings
asks for replay when evidence is insufficient

cases.prompt: 这个方向听起来可以，但我还没决定，先别记录。
invariants: does not create a decision card
does not change GDD, goals, tasks, code, or scenes

cases.prompt: 我确认采用你刚才建议的最小核心循环，请记录为给后续任务使用的决定。
invariants: creates exactly one Decision Card 0.1
uses a non-overwriting filename
records the confirmed decision rather than the full transcript
does not modify any other project artifact

cases.prompt: 讨论这个新手战斗教学既是否易懂，也是否超出两周范围。
invariants: loads no more than two lens references
produces one integrated recommendation instead of two independent reports
